description: Set the value of clump attributes. This command is a synonym for the clump initialize command. Individual attributes can be listed with the clump list command and all attributes can be visualized. Clump attributes are characteristics of the clumps such as position or size. Attributes that can be set include density, damp, volume, position, velocity, spin, displacement, force-applied, moment-applied, moment of inertia (moi), and euler orientation. These are distinct from clump properties (assigned with the clump property command) that are surface properties of the clumps that are used to fill contact model properties.

6.0: Modification of clump geometry will fail if the resulting clump would not fall entirely within the model domain
Be aware of the distinction between attributes and properties! See tutorial 'Attributes and Properties' for details
Specifying moment of inertia or volume via command line sets them to fixed state (not auto-updated when scaling/changing density)

Modifiers, read back live on 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8: 'add', 'multiply' and 'replace' go BEFORE the value ('velocity-x add 1.0', 'density multiply 2'); 'gradient <v>' goes AFTER a scalar value ('velocity-x 1.0 gradient 0 0 1' stores value + gradient . position) and is rejected after a vector value. A trailing add/multiply/replace and the gradient-x/y/z spellings fail, after the plain value has already been assigned.
7.0: Modifiers, read back live on 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8: 'add', 'multiply' and 'replace' go BEFORE the value ('velocity-x add 1.0', 'density multiply 2'); 'gradient <v>' goes AFTER a scalar value ('velocity-x 1.0 gradient 0 0 1' stores value + gradient . position) and is rejected after a vector value. A trailing add/multiply/replace and the gradient-x/y/z spellings fail, after the plain value has already been assigned.
9.0: Modifiers, read back live on 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8: 'add', 'multiply' and 'replace' go BEFORE the value ('velocity-x add 1.0', 'density multiply 2'); 'gradient <v>' goes AFTER a scalar value ('velocity-x 1.0 gradient 0 0 1' stores value + gradient . position) and is rejected after a vector value. A trailing add/multiply/replace and the gradient-x/y/z spellings fail, after the plain value has already been assigned.
'[clmodblock]' at the end of a keyword's syntax is not a literal token: it marks the modifier slot described above.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: Use Clump.set_*() methods (e.g., Clump.set_density(), Clump.set_vel(), Clump.set_pos()) - requires iteration over clump range

keywords.name: moi-11
keywords.description: 11 component of the clump real moment of inertia. When modified, only the clump principal moments of inertia are modified and the other clump attributes are not changed (e.g., volume, pebble sizes). The specification of the clump principal moments of inertia via the command line or via FISH results in the principal moments of inertia being in a fixed state so that they will not be automatically updated when scaling a clump, changing the volume, or changing the density. The fix state can be modified in FISH (see the clump.moi.fix intrinsic).

keywords.name: moi
keywords.description: Real moment of inertia. Use this keyword in 2D: the moi-11 to moi-33 and moi-principal keywords are 3D only. When modified, clump.moi.real takes the value, clump.moi keeps its value, and the real moment of inertia goes into a fixed state so that it will not be automatically updated when scaling, changing the volume, or changing the density. The fix state can be modified in FISH (see the clump.moi.fix intrinsic).

keywords.name: volume
keywords.description: Clump volume. When modified, only the clump mass and real mass are modified and the other clump attributes based on volume are not changed (e.g., moment of inertia, pebble sizes). The specification of the volume via the command line or via FISH results in the principal moments of inertia being in a fixed state so that they will not be automatically updated when scaling a clump, changing the volume, or changing the density. The fixity state of the inertia can be modified in FISH (see the clump.moi.fix intrinsic).

keywords.name: multiply

keywords.name: replace
keywords.description: Replace the existing value with the value that follows (the default): '<attribute> replace <value>'.

keywords.name: gradient
keywords.description: Apply a linear gradient in each of the axes directions starting at the origin.
